text:
megan (AE): @sam fyi — Starboard Health sent a SIG questionnaire + CAIQ link, asking for answers before their board call next Tue. gist: data residency, KMS, SOC2 artifacts. doc: https://docs.google.com/sig/starboard-answers (they expect redlines) :wave:
megan (AE): also asking POC timeline and any pricing uplift for dedicated/private deployment — can we confirm today?
sam (Security PM): thanks. I can take this. quick Q: is this full SIG or CAIQ-lite?
megan (AE): full SIG, 120 questions. they also attached a data flow diagram in the thread.
sam (Security PM): ok. priority = high. I'll triage into sections: network/firewall, auth/IAM, crypto/KMS, compliance artifacts. expecting 2-3 business days for initial draft.
anita (SecEng): I'll own network and cryptography questions. please add any host/VPC diagrams and the KMS vendor details.
ryan (SE): I can help with POC notes and the dedicated/private config matrix. sample snippet to show them:
```
deployment:
  mode: private-vpc
  kms_integration: aws-kms (customer-key)
  endpoint_policy: allowlist
```
ryan (SE): for pricing, clarify whether they want reserved capacity or pilot burst usage — both change quote.
megan (AE): they'll start with a 6-week pilot (likely dedicated). I told them we need a security signoff + purchase order by end of month.
sam (Security PM): please upload the questionnaire copy to the security queue and tag me. I'll create a tracker and assign Qs to owners.
megan (AE): uploaded: https://redwood-internal/share/queues/req-2248.pdf — pinged @anita @ryan
triage-bot: ticket created: SEC-2248 — owners: sam, anita, ryan. ETA: 2024-05-03.
anita (SecEng): small ask — do we need to include audit logs retention policy? I can draft a standard blurb (90 days default + options).
sam (Security PM): yes include retention + how to export logs to customer's SIEM. ryan, please add sample config for log export.
ryan (SE): will add config + sample curl for streaming logs to customer's endpoint. will post by EOD.
megan (AE): thx team — I'll push the timeline with the customer and flag if board call moves. :thumbsup:
sam (Security PM): noted. I'll post the initial answers in the ticket and request a review from legal if anything nonstandard shows up.
megan (AE): one last thing — Starboard asked about encrypted-at-rest details for embeddings. any short boilerplate we can use?
anita (SecEng): yes. use this line: "All model artifacts and token caches are encrypted at rest using customer-managed keys via KMS when configured; default encryption uses AES-256." I'll add it to the draft.
sam (Security PM): wrapping up — expect draft in ticket by tomorrow midday. if anyone hits blockers ping me in-thread. :eyes:
